raw.details:
CampusQuest – Innovation Hackathon 2026

Organized by: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT), in collaboration with the approved student organizing communities.

About CampusQuest

CampusQuest is a beginner-friendly innovation challenge designed to introduce school students to technology, creativity, and real-world problem-solving. Participants will explore problem statements, develop innovative ideas, and experience the process of turning an idea into a practical solution.

No prior coding experience is required. Curiosity, creativity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn are encouraged.

Event Timeline

1. Mock Round — 24 October 2026

Time: 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST

The mock screening round will help participants familiarize themselves with the online assessment format and prepare for the upcoming Stage 1 quiz.

Topics covered:

  • Logical reasoning and analytical puzzles

  • Quantitative aptitude and mathematics

  • Basic programming and computational thinking

  • Number patterns and brain teasers

The objective is to improve problem-solving skills, time management, and confidence before the screening round.

2. Stage 1 – Quiz Round — 25 October 2026

Time: 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM IST

Participants will take an online quiz on Unstop to assess their knowledge, logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Quiz performance will be considered alongside the evaluation of the Problem Statement Abstract when shortlisting participants for the offline workshop and hackathon.

3. Abstract Submission — 23–26 October 2026

Submission opens: 23 October 2026, 7:00 AM IST
Deadline: 26 October 2026, 11:59 PM IST

Participants must submit a PDF abstract proposing an interactive digital learning experience.

Abstract writing question:

Technology has changed the way we learn. Instead of simply reading about a topic, imagine being able to explore it, interact with it, and experience it through a digital platform.

Choose a topic that interests you and propose an interactive digital experience that could make learning about it more engaging, visual, and enjoyable.

Your abstract should explain:

  1. What you want users to explore or learn about.

  2. How an interactive website could make the learning experience better.

  3. What features, interactions, or visual elements you would include.

Important: Both the Stage 1 quiz performance and abstract evaluation will be considered for shortlisting. Participants should complete both activities to be considered.

4. Offline Workshop – RGIPT Campus — 31 October 2026

Time: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM IST

Shortlisted participants will attend an offline, hands-on workshop at Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT), Jais, Uttar Pradesh.

Venue details, reporting time, campus entry instructions, and other necessary information will be shared with shortlisted participants through official event communication channels.

5. Final Hackathon – RGIPT Campus — 1 November 2026

Time: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM IST

Shortlisted participants will participate in the final offline hackathon at RGIPT. They will work on their innovative ideas, develop solutions, and present their outcomes.

Reporting time, venue instructions, and other event details will be communicated to selected participants through official channels.

Eligibility

School students interested in technology, innovation, creativity, and problem-solving are encouraged to participate. No prior coding experience is required.

Participation and Registration

  • Participation mode: Individual

  • Registration fee: Free

  • Quiz platform: Unstop

  • Abstract format: PDF

  • Shortlisting criteria: Stage 1 quiz performance and abstract evaluation

  • Offline venue: RGIPT campus, Jais, Uttar Pradesh

Important Instructions

  1. Participate in the mock round to familiarize yourself with the quiz format.

  2. Complete the Stage 1 quiz on 25 October 2026 during the scheduled time.

  3. Submit your Problem Statement Abstract as a PDF by 26 October 2026, 11:59 PM IST.

  4. Both the quiz and abstract are important for shortlisting.

  5. Shortlisted participants must follow the official instructions for the offline workshop and final hackathon.

Further information regarding reporting time, campus entry, and event requirements will be communicated to selected participants through official event communication channels.

Contact Information

  • Email: secyscitech@rgipt.ac.in

  • Email: geeksforgeeks@rgipt.ac.in
